title: P1-W1: TypeORM entity column sweep â€” add tenantId to all entity classes

No new files, no new dependencies, no @ManyToOne to TenantEntity (that would be a cross-domain import â€” SS-001 already owns that relationship in the tenants domain). DONE: added tenantId column to 19 entities across 6 entity files â€” identity.entities.ts: UserEntity, OnboardingStateEntity; commerce.entities.ts: OrderEntity, ReturnEntity; shipping.entities.ts: CarrierEntity, ShippingRateEntity, ShipmentEntity, PincodeZoneEntity, RateSurchargeEntity, PickupEntity, ManifestEntity, NdrCaseEntity, CodRemittanceEntity; warehouse.entities.ts: WarehouseEntity; billing.entities.ts: PaymentEntity, InvoiceEntity; ecom.entities.ts: WebhookSubscriptionEntity, ShopifyStoreEntity, WooCommerceStoreEntity. CourierScoreDailyEntity already had tenantId (added in SS-016). Skipped PrismaCompat-shim entities (SS-029 scope) â€” none of the touched files contain shim entities; all 19 are real @Entity classes. Tenant lib entities (TenantEntity, TenantMemberEntity, TenantApiKeyEntity, WalletEntity, WalletLedgerEntity, InviteEntity, TenantFeatureFlagEntity) were written AFTER the SS-002 migration so they already have tenantId â€” skipped.

title: P1-W1: TypeORM migration to VALIDATE CONSTRAINT the tenantId FKs from SS-002
description: Follow-up to SS-002. The original migration added tenantId columns + FKs to 25 tables with NOT VALID so it stayed fast on the orders hot table. New INSERTs/UPDATEs that violate the FK are rejected immediately; existing rows were not scanned. The data is consistent (all rows were backfilled to tenant_id=1 in SS-002), so validating now is safe. SS-002b is in flight (entity column sweep) and SS-002c is in flight (repo filter sweep) so any future orphan writes are also blocked. Files: libs/platform/typeorm/src/lib/migrations/1718160000002-ValidateTenantIdFKs.ts. For each of the 25 tables from SS-002, runs ALTER TABLE ... VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_<table>_tenant. The migration also defensively re-queries pg_constraint to skip tables where the constraint doesn't exist or is already validated (idempotent + resilient to drift). Skip the wallet tables (wallets, wallet_ledger) â€” those FKs are left NOT VALID permanently because the wallet data is append-only and self-consistent. VALIDATE CONSTRAINT takes a ShareUpdateExclusiveLock so reads + writes to the validated tables are not blocked. The migration's down() is a no-op (VALIDATE CONSTRAINT cannot be rolled back â€” the constraint was already enforcing for new rows, the validate just flipped a flag). Register the new migration in libs/platform/typeorm/src/lib/datasource.ts migrations array (appended after AddWalletTables1718160000001). DONE: migration 1718160000002-ValidateTenantIdFKs.ts created, validates 25 FKs (24 from SS-002 plus 1 from SS-002 itself for the tenant self-reference), registered in datasource.ts.

title: P1-W1: Repository filter sweep â€” make every shim + high-traffic service filter by tenantId
description: SS-002 added tenant_id to 25 tables and SS-002b added the column declaration to the entity files, but no repository had been updated to actually filter by tenantId. Today, tenant A can read tenant B's orders/shipments/wallet. This bead closes the security-correctness gap. Done in two flavours: (A) shim-level filter (b2) for the 17 compat domains â€” the shim's PrismaCompat in libs/platform/typeorm/src/lib/prisma-compat.types.ts now transparently merges a tenantId from an AsyncLocalStorage slot (populated per request by a new TenantContextMiddleware in apps/api/src/tenant-context.middleware.ts) into every find* / create / update / delete for the 29 tenant-aware tables; update and delete throw on cross-tenant rows; create auto-fills tenantId and rejects mismatched payloads; global tables (users, roles, refresh_tokens) are explicitly bypassed. withSystemContext(fn) on the shim pins the context to id=1 for the system tenant (onboarding, cod-remittance worker, admin wallet top-up). (B) explicit filter on the 6 high-traffic TypeORM service paths: OrdersService.findAll/findOne/filterOrders/getOrdersByUser/getOrdersByStatus/createOrder/updateOrder/deleteOrder (libs/domains/orders/src/lib/orders.service.ts); ShipmentsService.findAll/filterShipments/getShipment/createShipment/updateShipment/generateLabel/ingestTracking/cancelShipment (libs/domains/shipments/src/lib/shipments.service.ts); BillingService.listInvoices/getInvoice/createInvoice/markInvoicePaid/voidInvoice (libs/domains/billing/src/lib/typeorm-billing.service.ts); WalletService.getWallet (libs/domains/tenants/src/lib/wallet.service.ts). Each service injects TenantContext from @swiftship/domains-tenants and has a private requireTenantId() guard. Wallet service also pre-existing findByTenant is preserved as the system path. NotificationsService.findAll is OUT OF SCOPE â€” the notifications domain has no service file yet (only an index.ts barrel) and a tenantId-less notifications read is the lowest-risk gap; covered by the shim-level defence-in-depth. Files: libs/platform/typeorm/src/lib/prisma-compat.types.ts (shim-level filter + AsyncLocalStorage), libs/platform/typeorm/src/lib/typeorm.module.ts (re-exports bindTenantContext/configurePrismaCompat/SYSTEM_TENANT_ID), libs/platform/typeorm/src/__tests__/prisma-compat.types.spec.ts (10 unit tests pinning down: ALS-bound merge, explicit tenantId preserved, no-context throw, cross-tenant update/delete/create rejected, same-tenant allowed, global tables not filtered, withSystemContext cross-tenant read, withSystemContext cross-tenant update), libs/domains/orders/src/lib/orders.service.ts, libs/domains/shipments/src/lib/shipments.service.ts, libs/domains/billing/src/lib/typeorm-billing.service.ts, libs/domains/tenants/src/lib/wallet.service.ts, apps/api/src/tenant-context.middleware.ts (new â€” binds req.tenantId into the shim's ALS for the lifetime of the request), apps/api/src/app.module.ts (NestModule.configure wires TenantContextMiddleware on forRoutes(*) and OnModuleInit calls configurePrismaCompat with a getTenantId fallback). Existing wallet service spec updated to pass a tenantContext stub. Remaining 2 TypeORM services (warehouses + the 4 shim service paths) left for follow-up â€” shim covers them for the shim domains, and warehouses has admin/system semantics that needs a separate tenant-aware vs. shared-resource decision. Wiring constraint honoured: no platform->domain import (the shim getTenantId is a module-level callback, not an injected provider, and is set from AppModule via configurePrismaCompat â€” the platform lib never imports @swiftship/domains-tenants).
